getters.title: Bundle Status
getters.description: Summarize bundle health and high-level registry counts.
use_when: check whether a bundle is readable

getters.title: Bundle Manifest
getters.description: Read the atomically published authoritative manifest, or request an explicitly reconstructed diagnostic registry view.
use_when: inspect durable bundle identity and current state

getters.title: Bundle Overview
getters.description: Summarize bundle identity, validation state, registries, artifact counts, and provenance heads for read-only clients.
use_when: inspect bundle readiness without direct SQL

getters.title: Bundle Schema
getters.description: Inspect available SQLite schema objects in the bundle.

getters.title: Registry List
getters.description: List common registry tables such as matrices, features, spaces, or datasets.

getters.title: Cell IDs
getters.description: Return cell IDs in canonical bundle order, optionally restricted to a cell set or dataset.
use_when: resolve a cell set to cell IDs

getters.title: Cell Sets
getters.description: List available cell sets in a bundle.
use_when: choose cell_set input for an op

getters.title: Resolve Cell Set
getters.description: Resolve a cell-set selector into concrete cell IDs.

getters.title: Cell Metadata
getters.description: Read cell-level metadata for selected cells and columns.

getters.title: Cell Metadata Columns
getters.description: List cell metadata columns with type, missingness, cardinality, and display hints for clients.

getters.title: Canonical Metadata Fields
getters.description: List durable source, display, stable, and physical identities for cell metadata fields.
use_when: inspect imported rename and coercion evidence
choose stable IDs for ambiguous names

getters.title: Resolve Metadata Field
getters.description: Resolve one stable ID or unambiguous metadata name to its durable mapping.
use_when: obtain the physical mapping without SQLite access

getters.title: Cell Coverage
getters.description: Summarize which cells are covered by matrices, spaces, and sets.
getters.use_when: check data coverage before running ops

getters.title: Cells With Matrix
getters.description: List cells available for a given matrix.

getters.title: Cells With Space
getters.description: List cells available for a given space.

getters.title: Matrices
getters.description: List matrices available in the bundle.
getters.use_when: choose matrix input for an op

getters.title: Matrix Info
getters.description: Read matrix registry metadata, optionally for one matrix.
getters.use_when: inspect matrix type, dimensions, and metadata

getters.title: Matrix Fragments
getters.description: List physical storage fragments backing a logical matrix.

getters.title: Resolve Matrix
getters.description: Resolve matrix fragments to absolute storage paths.

getters.title: Matrix Handle
getters.description: Open a matrix handle for a matrix ID.

getters.title: Matrix Slice
getters.description: Read a feature-by-cell matrix slice.

getters.title: Read One Feature
getters.description: Read one feature vector across requested cells.
getters.use_when: inspect one gene or peak across cells

getters.title: Read Features
getters.description: Read multiple features across cells from a logical matrix.

getters.title: Feature Vector
getters.description: Get a single feature vector across cells.

getters.title: Features
getters.description: Read feature registry rows, optionally filtered by matrix or feature type.

getters.title: Feature IDs
getters.description: Get feature IDs in canonical order for a matrix.

getters.title: Search Features
getters.description: Search feature IDs or feature metadata.

getters.title: Feature Sets
getters.description: List feature sets and namespaces in the bundle.
use_when: choose namespace for enrichment or dynamics

getters.title: Feature Set Info
getters.description: Read metadata for one feature set.

getters.title: Feature Set Members
getters.description: Get feature IDs from one feature set.

getters.title: Spaces
getters.description: List spaces in the bundle.
getters.use_when: choose embedding or latent space for an op

getters.title: Space Info
getters.description: Read space registry metadata, optionally for one space.

getters.title: Space Coordinates
getters.description: Read coordinates for a space, optionally restricted to cells and dimensions.

getters.title: Spaces With Model
getters.description: List space IDs that have a stored projection model.

getters.title: Space Model Metadata
getters.description: Get model metadata for a space.
getters.use_when: inspect fitted UMAP or projection model metadata

getters.title: Space Model Path
getters.description: Get absolute path to a stored model file for a space.

getters.title: Artifacts
getters.description: List current promoted artifacts by default, optionally filtered by type or expanded to retained history.
use_when: choose artifact for plotting or loading

getters.title: Durable Entity Lifecycle
getters.description: List current, superseded, rejected, retracted, and ephemeral durable entity identities without reading physical storage tables.
use_when: distinguish current claims from historical evidence

getters.title: Entity Supersessions
getters.description: List explicit SUPERSEDES relationships between immutable durable identities.

getters.title: Trajectory Model Inventory
getters.description: List promoted model_ref trajectory candidates with engine, provenance, and optional pseudotime coverage.
use_when: review trajectory candidates for reports or agents

getters.title: Trajectory Lineage Weights
getters.description: Load Slingshot lineage membership weights as a cell_vector_family from a promoted lineage_weights artifact, promoted sibling trajectory artifact, or in-memory Slingshot model_ref fallback.
use_when: restrict trajectory universes by lineage membership
filter cells by Slingshot lineage weight

getters.title: Trajectory Fit Identity
getters.description: Inspect the trajectory_fit_id, engine, lineage keys, and available cell universe metadata for a trajectory primitive or promoted artifact.
use_when: check whether trajectory artifacts can be combined

getters.title: Trajectory Fit Compatibility Assertion
getters.description: Fail loudly when trajectory artifacts come from different trajectory fit families; shared labels such as L1 are not sufficient compatibility evidence.
use_when: validate pseudotime, weights, model, and path compatibility

getters.title: Load Artifact
getters.description: Load a promoted artifact as a primitive.

getters.title: Table Artifact Info
getters.description: Read metadata for a promoted table artifact.

getters.title: Table Artifact Slice
getters.description: Read a bounded row slice from a promoted feature_table or obs_table.
use_when: preview artifact table without full load

getters.title: Table Artifact Distinct Values
getters.description: List distinct values from one promoted table artifact column.
use_when: find feature sets in an artifact

getters.description: Summarize artifact identity, provenance, labels, and display hints.
getters.use_when: explain an artifact to an agent or user

getters.description: Read provenance/birth metadata for a promoted artifact.

getters.title: Artifact Dependencies
getters.description: Get dependency relationships for an artifact.

getters.title: Related Trajectory Artifacts
getters.description: Find trajectory-related sibling artifacts for a source artifact.
getters.use_when: navigate between trajectory DE, smooth, and signature artifacts

getters.description: List available cell vectors from artifacts and optionally session outputs.

getters.title: Vector Sources
getters.description: List vector-like sources available for UI/agent selection.

getters.title: Read Cell Vector
getters.description: Read a scalar cell vector for a requested set of cells.

getters.title: Read Cell Vector Family Member
getters.description: Read one key/member from a cell_vector_family for requested cells.

getters.title: Load Cell Vector Primitive
getters.description: Load a cell vector primitive by artifact or session reference.
getters.use_when: resolve vector reference for plotting or ops

getters.title: Motif Libraries
getters.description: List registered motif libraries.

getters.title: Motifs
getters.description: List motifs, optionally filtered by library.
getters.use_when: find motif IDs for regulatory analysis

getters.title: Motif Match Sets
getters.description: List motif match sets available for peak features.

getters.title: Motif Match Membership
getters.description: Load motif match membership rows for a match set.

getters.title: Provenance Heads
getters.description: List persisted provenance snapshot heads.

getters.title: Provenance DAG
getters.description: Read one snapshot-local persisted provenance DAG.
use_when: reconstruct analysis steps within one snapshot

getters.title: Bundle-Level Composed Provenance DAG
getters.description: Compose persisted runs, artifacts, snapshots, artifact inputs, outputs, and registry mutations across all bundle provenance snapshots.
use_when: render a connected artifact/run lineage across promotions
show bundle-level provenance in Shiny or agents
trace analysis chains that continue from promoted artifacts

getters.title: Target Reproduction Plan
getters.description: Resolve an artifact, matrix, space, model, or run DAG node into its minimal cross-snapshot replay closure.
use_when: export the minimum reproducible path to a durable result
distinguish imported source state from engine-reproducible output

getters.title: Target Reproduction Script
getters.description: Emit a replay-and-promotion script for a target reproduction plan and writable execution clone.
getters.use_when: hand off a target-specific reproducible analysis path

getters.title: Replay Equivalence Results
getters.description: List target-reproduction equivalence results with separate original and replayed payload SHA-256 identities.
getters.use_when: audit scientific replay equality separately from stored-payload integrity

getters.title: Composed Artifact Lineage
getters.description: Return an upstream, downstream, or bidirectional composed provenance subgraph centered on one promoted artifact.
use_when: find upstream source artifacts and downstream dependents

getters.title: Provenance Run Details
getters.description: Inspect one persisted run from provenance.
getters.use_when: explain exact inputs and params for one run

getters.title: Run History
getters.description: Flatten persisted provenance snapshots into a chronological run-history table.

getters.title: Session DAG
getters.description: Inspect an in-memory session DAG.

getters.title: Session DAG Run Details
getters.description: Inspect one run node from an in-memory session DAG.

getters.title: Session Staging View
getters.description: Open the session-local bundle overlay containing staged outputs before promotion.
use_when: inspect staged matrix or space output before promotion
continue session-local analysis without mutating the portable bundle

getters.title: Navigation Entities
getters.description: List entities that can be navigated from an artifact-backed source.
getters.use_when: find clickable genes, lineages, or feature sets

getters.title: Navigation Targets
getters.description: List compatible navigation targets for a selected source/entity.
getters.use_when: find next plot/table from an artifact

getters.title: Navigation Handoff
